source_policy: All numeric constants below are reconstruction unless explicitly noted. Raw ability/effect payloads remain source-backed candidates and must not be rewritten to fit this model.
pipeline: validate action / weapon / program / cooldown / ammo-resource
resolve target, range, geometry and incoming direction
resolve Accuracy vs Defense hit result where applicable
for explosion/ground AoE resolve per-target LoS + blast exposure
apply item-bound TechComp/quality/ammo scaling to numeric payload
resolve matching armor mitigation and penetration
resolve statuses and explicit resist rolls

Stealth: Generic direct damage when explicit mitigation is present

armor_resistance_penetration.rule: Penetration reduces armor mitigation only. It does not reduce Mental/Kinetic/Health status-resist ratings.

rules: paired F/H attack: apply mitigated Focus damage first, then roll the ordinary Health component
health-only effects bypass the Focus health-exposure gate
focus-only effects never invent Health damage
roll once per damaging pulse/effect so Health exposure can rise as Focus drains
heals affect only their explicit pool and clamp to maximum
use only where the linked effect requests a resistance roll
Mental Resist Roll -> Mental Resist
Kinetic Resist Roll -> Kinetic Resist
Health Resist Roll -> Health Resist
immunity moniker overrides generic roll with 0% application chance
without a resist-roll effect, state applies on successful parent effect unless immune
same status does not add duration; use max(current_remaining,new_duration)
use explosion/detonation origin as incoming direction for target cover
hard world-geometry occlusion blocks blast damage/status
soft cover multiplies blast damage by exposure
post-resist status application chance is multiplied by blast exposure
ground-target detonation does not add a second ordinary Accuracy-vs-Defense roll unless ability semantics require it
cone attacks use normal per-target attack/cover resolution, not blast exposure
persistent ground hazards ignore cover after a target is inside the hazard volume
melee ignores cover tier but may still use normal Defense/crouch

applies_to: Asgard program numeric payloads when bound to equipped program
rules: Tier is progression/classification metadata only in v1
Applied Science ID has no hidden generic multiplier; explicit effects only
character level has no hidden generic payload multiplier

Incendiary.rule: Use recovered fire/DoT effects; no invented generic DoT.

stacking_caps.flat_rating_mods: different monikers sum; same moniker strongest absolute value wins and refreshes
stacking_caps.percent_mods: different monikers sum then clamp to stat-specific cap; same moniker does not stack
stacking_caps.stances: one active per stance family; new stance replaces old
stacking_caps.different_dot_hot_monikers: may coexist unless explicit rule forbids

still_unrecovered_retail_facts: original armor aggregation and penetration formula
original Tier/Applied Science generic scaling if any
